description: Returns a short, free reading based only on a birth date: sun sign (simple date table) and Pythagorean life path number, with a few sentences about character, written in the third person by default. No predictions, no personal data stored.

birth_date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 1988-03-14. Birth time and place are not needed.

voice.description: Optional voice of the reading: 'third_person' (default, about someone born under the sign) or 'second_person' (addresses the reader as 'you').

name: get_sun_sign_reading
title: Stellara Sun Sign Reading
